reviews.t: ok, but nothing special for the price
reviews.x: This is NOT a bad product, in fact it is quite nice. However my skin did not feel any different or cleaner than it does after I use my usual organic cleansers that costs half the price. I found it quite curious that the 4  5 Star reviews are written by people that only reviewed products by this company, seems a little fishy to me. Having said that, if money is no object, this is a nice cleanser, but there are others that do the job just as well and are also all natural that cost half the price.

But I have always wanted to find something equally helpful that was not as chemically harsh. This completely fits the bill. Im half way through my first bottle and have stumbled upon a product I'll never be without. I've never been one to try a lot of products, just used purpose liquid face soap for the last 20 years. This stuff has improved my skin, smells incredible and a little goes a long way. My pores appear smaller as they are clean for the first time ever. Love it.

I love this gentle cleanser. I have mostly oily skin, and use a glycolic cleanser once a week to control breakouts. But the glycolic is too strong to use everyday, so I use the Detox cleanser daily. I feel the Detox Cleanser really cleans my skin, but isn't harsh at all. My skin is soft and supple, and well balanced. I love the silky texture.

MMMM..this would be a great product if it was not watered down. It is a very thin consistency which I assume is done to save money but really...its water thin and just drips off my face. I do not feel it gets anything clean and I have to use so much at one time. Overpriced and not a good product in general. I would stick with Origins brand before buying this if I was you!

From the first time I used this product I've seen an improvement in my skin! Super Detox cleans so deeply removing all the urban grime trapped in my enlarged pores, leaving my face as soft as a baby's bottom! I LOVE IT!!!!

I have been a fan of Angel Face's Kissed cleanser for some time, but when I became pregnant my normally calm skin totally freaked out and I needed serious help. The cleanser is super light and has an awesome citrus smell. Thank you Angel Face!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the cleanser leaves their skin feeling clean, soft, and improved, with some noting smaller pores and clearer complexions.
Several reviewers praise the pleasant scent, describing it as minty, citrusy, or floral.
A common complaint is that the product is too thin and watery, with some feeling it doesn't clean well or requires using too much.
Some reviewers feel the product is overpriced for its small bottle size or that it performs no better than cheaper alternatives.
Reviewers with oily or problem skin report it cleans effectively without being harsh.
